headline: Matchweek 7: City host Ipswich on Saturday. No Friday score
whyCareReason: City are still perfect on 18 points. The Etihad kickoff is Saturday 15:00 BST. Friday does not move the table.
teaser: Manchester City (18) host Ipswich (9). Arsenal are three points back and play Forest on Sunday. No match is listed for Friday.
story: Match XI lists Manchester City against Ipswich Town on Saturday 17 October at 14:00 UTC, 15:00 BST, at the Etihad Stadium. City lead the Premier League with 18 points from six wins. Ipswich are 10th on 9 points. NBC Sports and Match XI agree the table has not changed since Monday: Arsenal 15, Brighton 13. Everton play Chelsea at 12:30 BST the same day. Brentford play Liverpool at 15:00. There is no Friday fixture and no Friday score.
stakes: A City win would make it seven from seven and keep a gap of at least three points heading into Sunday, when Arsenal visit Nottingham Forest.
rivalryAngle: The leaders against a side on 9 points. The table is frozen until Saturday.
